scope: The in-tree MRI reconstruction Provider taxonomy. Host/runtime services, ingress/egress adapters, and test-only fixtures are intentionally outside this catalog. An implemented-development entry has a checked-in module and OperatorContract; every planned entry reserves only its identity and OperatorInterface until an executable Provider is deliberately implemented.

providers.responsibility: Condition assembled k-space before reconstruction without owning source transport, frame assembly, buffer accounting, or public MRI ingress.
providers.lifecycle_boundary: Serial synchronous frame-local conditioning with explicit calibration input batches where required. The Provider retains no input, runs no asynchronous work, and produces no terminal output; executor-owned calibration bindings source immutable artifacts from CalibrationArtifactStore.

operators.summary: Whiten k-space samples with an explicit scan-bound noise model.
Correct k-space with an explicit scan-bound phase model.
Project k-space onto an explicit virtual-coil basis.
Remove readout oversampling while preserving the remaining k-space axes.
Whiten channel-major non-Cartesian k-space samples with an explicit scan-bound noise model.
Project channel-major non-Cartesian k-space samples onto an explicit virtual-coil basis.
Apply a sequence-specific non-Cartesian phase model without reusing the Cartesian [channel,kx] model.

providers.responsibility: Estimate explicit scan-bound calibration artifacts for conditioning, accelerated reconstruction, and adaptive coil combination. It does not apply those artifacts to imaging frames, perform reconstruction or coil combination, or create runtime readiness tokens.
providers.lifecycle_boundary: Synchronous one-frame estimation of explicit immutable calibration artifacts. The implemented estimators retain no input or shared calibration state; each artifact reaches a consumer only through an explicit calibration binding.

operators.summary: Estimate one scan-bound noise model from a noise-calibration frame.
Estimate one scan-bound phase-correction model from a phase-reference frame.
Estimate a sequence-specific non-Cartesian phase model from non-Cartesian phase references.
Estimate one scan-bound virtual-coil compression basis from k-space.
Calibrate one scan-bound Cartesian GRAPPA kernel from calibration k-space.
Estimate scan-bound sensitivity maps from complex coil images.

providers.responsibility: Perform Cartesian k-space-to-image reconstruction stages. Coil combination remains a separate Provider and host/runtime services remain outside this boundary.
providers.lifecycle_boundary: Cartesian frame reconstruction with explicit calibration artifacts for accelerated methods. Each future executable contract must separately declare its finite workspace, calibration and terminal behavior.

operators.summary: Perform the two-dimensional inverse Cartesian transform independently for every receive channel and retain complex coil images.
Complete a partial-Fourier Cartesian k-space frame before image reconstruction.
Recover missing Cartesian k-space samples with an explicit scan-bound GRAPPA kernel.
Reconstruct a Cartesian image from undersampled multi-coil k-space and explicit sensitivity maps.

providers.responsibility: Perform bounded non-Cartesian k-space-to-complex-coil-image reconstruction without defining a scanner protocol, coil combination, or hidden calibration state.
providers.lifecycle_boundary: Trajectory-bearing frame reconstruction. The implemented direct adjoint and explicit 2-D radial linear-gridding paths are synchronous and frame-local; trajectory correction and sensitivity-encoded reconstruction remain separate planned boundaries.

operators.summary: Correct the trajectory carried with a non-Cartesian k-space frame.
Apply an unweighted bounded direct non-Cartesian adjoint and produce complex coil images.
Apply bounded 2-D radial linear gridding with explicit analytic-ramp density compensation and produce complex coil images.
Reconstruct one non-Cartesian image from multi-coil k-space and explicit sensitivity maps.

providers.responsibility: Combine complex coil images after reconstruction. It does not perform Cartesian or non-Cartesian reconstruction and does not estimate hidden calibration state.
providers.lifecycle_boundary: Frame-local complex coil-image combination. Adaptive combination remains a separate future Operator with an explicit sensitivity-map input; this Provider never estimates or hides calibration state.

operators.summary: Combine complex coil images into a real image by root-sum-of-squares magnitude.
Combine complex coil images with explicit scan-bound sensitivity maps.

providers.responsibility: Apply local image-domain transforms with one coherent image ABI and synchronous per-item lifecycle. Scan-wide normalization and image-quality policy are separate Provider boundaries.
providers.lifecycle_boundary: Stateless or frame-local image transforms. A future OperatorContract must declare exact typed ports; the Provider ABI must declare executable capability bounds and each node use must bind finite planning requirements and terminal behavior.

operators.summary: Scale every float32 image sample by an explicit finite factor.
Add an explicit finite offset to every float32 image sample.
Clamp every float32 image sample to explicit finite lower and upper bounds.
Convert one complex image to a float32 magnitude image.
Convert one complex image to a float32 phase image.
Crop a float32 image to an explicitly configured region of interest.
Apply an explicit display/intensity window to a float32 image.

providers.responsibility: Normalize reconstructed images under an explicit normalization policy. This is separate from local image transforms because a future implementation may require scan- or series-scoped statistics and retention.
providers.lifecycle_boundary: Normalization policy and its possible scan/series state form one boundary. A future executable contract must declare statistic scope, retention, finite bounds, output timing, and EndOfInput behavior.

operators.summary: Normalize one image or a declared bounded image set according to an explicit policy.

providers.responsibility: Validate image payload quality and make policy failures explicit while preserving the host/runtime's resource and delivery responsibilities.
providers.lifecycle_boundary: Frame-local pass-through validation with an explicit fail policy. Future executable contracts must declare error propagation, finite resources, and terminal behavior.

operators.summary: Reject or report images containing non-finite samples under an explicit policy.
Validate image samples against explicit permitted bounds under an explicit policy.
